scientific_integrity: The integral homotopy conclusion rests on explicit face classification, exact simplicial pair sequences, and the primitive incidence matrix; independently verified finite examples corroborate rather than prove the all-size claim. No independent mathematical audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Applies to triangles of a complete tripartite graph with two deleted cross-part matchings whose endpoints are disjoint within each part, including the middle part; no overlapping defects, higher clique thresholds, or equivariant homotopy theorem. Finite replay checks nine examples and cannot replace the infinite proof.
title: A three-sphere-wedge law for triangle-avoidance complexes with two cross-part matching defects
